response: Intraoperative neuromonitoring (IONM) is associated with better functional outcomes in patients undergoing open total mesorectal excision (TME). Specifically, the use of IONM during TME has been linked to significantly lower rates of urinary and anorectal dysfunction. However, it is essential to note that prospective randomized trials are necessary to fully evaluate the role of IONM in rectal cancer surgery and confirm its benefits.
